active_work_item.reason: Canonical GitHub evidence shows CP13-04 is QA-passed and merged. Activate the final bounded engineering item: deterministic end-to-end regression across genuine local Quote 1 + Quote 2 inputs, extraction, grounded analysis, generated report/session continuity, trust invariants, safe image-provider failure, mobile/accessibility journey coverage, and owner-acceptance handoff.

commercial_milestone: Owner can personally select/upload 2-3 real quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis derived from those exact inputs without fabricated findings

save_game.verified_behavior: CP0-CP12 remain merged. CP13-01 provides genuine mobile-first Quote 1/2/3 file or pasted-text selection with replace/remove and Quote 1+2 gating. CP13-02 consumes exact pasted text/PDF bytes through real extraction adapters and stops image input at an explicit provider boundary when OCR is unavailable. CP13-03 sends exact selected sources/category through /api/analyze, source extraction, canonical evidence validation and grounded reasoning without demo substitution. CP13-04 binds the generated report to its server-scoped session and preserves same-session preview/unlock continuity without demo fallback.
save_game.risks: CP13-05 end-to-end regression and owner acceptance remain incomplete. Image OCR remains provider-required without an authorized provider. Default runtime analysis remains deterministic. Transitional extracted_text_fixture naming remains technical debt. Production deployment/live payments/storage/providers/secrets/DNS/customer communication/ads remain RED.
save_game.rollback: Return to CP13-04 merged SHA 9031c8db05932bf73fe7d6d3f662ef1339c97ae4 if CP13-05 introduces journey, trust, access, privacy or presentation regressions.

human_gate.when: After CP13-05 end-to-end regression independently QA-passes
